label: Mosca 2015
sub: historical point estimates · no interpretation band
provenance: Historical continuity dataset: point estimates from Dr. Michele Mosca's 2015 analysis (14% by 2026, 50% by 2031, 70% by 2035, 85% by 2040), as presented in the original ProteQC(R) Post-Quantum Risk Evaluator (darrenbender.com/pqc-risk-evaluator.html). No optimistic/pessimistic band existed; both columns carry the stated values, so band displays collapse to a single point estimate. Anchor keys are years elapsed from the nominal 2015-01-01 epoch. Not a QTTR survey; no Appendix A.4 raw bins exist for this dataset.
